{{Infobox auto}}
'''Sulfur goo''' is a sticky yellow item dropped by sulfur cubes. It is a vanilla {{MCW|Slimeball|slimeball}} with its own name and texture, so it works everywhere a slimeball does.

== Obtaining ==
{{Sources}}
A sulfur cube killed by a player drops 1–2 sulfur goo, along with 1–2 [[Sulfur Chunk|sulfur chunks]]. Sulfur cubes drop nothing in vanilla.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/entities/sulfur_cube.json}}</ref>

== Usage ==
Sulfur goo is a slimeball with an <code>item_model</code> component, so every vanilla recipe that takes a slimeball accepts it: sticky pistons, leads and slime blocks, for example.

It does not stack with ordinary slimeballs, because its components differ.
